name: navic
description: Navic route planner — MERN stack with a C++ graph-algorithms engine (Dijkstra, A*, BFS, DFS, Floyd–Warshall).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run build:dsa && npm run prepare-data
scripts.test: npm run test:dsa && npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
